subject: Oceanography
title: Types of Marine Sediment
description: A micro-lesson that makes Types of Marine Sediment usable.

hook.text: Every square centimeter of the deep ocean floor is blanketed by sediment—some of it millions of years old.

buildup.text: Marine sediments fall into four types: terrigenous, biogenous, hydrogenous, and cosmogenous.

discovery.text: Terrigenous sediment comes from land (river mud, wind-blown dust); biogenous comes from dead organisms.

twist.text: Cosmogenous sediment includes micrometeorites—tiny space particles that rain down constantly.

climax.text: Sediment type reveals distance from land, productivity of surface waters, and deep-water chemistry.

punchline.text: The ocean floor is a library—written in mud and bones.

quiz.question: Where does terrigenous sediment come from?
